name: io.github.WYRE-AI/kaseya-vsax-mcp
title: Kaseya VSA X
description: Read-only MCP server for Kaseya VSA X (VSA 10) — devices, assets, notifications, organizations, automation, patching.

environmentVariables.name: KASEYA_VSAX_SERVER_URL
environmentVariables.description: Tenant host, e.g. acme.vsax.net (must be a single label under .vsax.net)

environmentVariables.name: KASEYA_VSAX_TOKEN_ID
environmentVariables.description: API Token ID (Configuration > API Access > Third-Party Tokens)

environmentVariables.name: READ_ONLY_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Expose read tools only. Default true.

environmentVariables.name: DESTRUCTIVE_TOOLS_ENABLED
environmentVariables.description: Allow destructive tools (only effective when READ_ONLY_MODE=false). Default false.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_TRANSPORT
environmentVariables.description: Transport mode. 'stdio' for local CLI use; the image defaults to 'http' for gateway hosting.

environmentVariables.name: AUTH_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Credential source: 'env' reads vars locally, 'gateway' expects X-Kaseya-VSAX-* header injection from the WYRE MCP Gateway.
